**Summary of findings:** El Puerto de Santa María has exactly one 2+-star Michelin restaurant — **Aponiente ★★★** (Ángel León). For 2026 it has transformed into a radical 3-hour immersive salt-marsh journey at €400/person, open Wed–Sat from March 11. The 1-star **Tohqa** in El Puerto closed in October 2025. The two nearest 2-star options require a short drive: **LÚ Cocina y Alma ★★** in Jerez (~25 min, €180–210, run by Aponiente's former head chef) and **Alevante ★★** in Sancti Petri (~35 min, ~€175, also Ángel León's concept).
